propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock due to function-scoped rebar_repo running git init and initialization per-test, with 306 ms per test across 589 consumers.

A session-scoped template fixture with per-test copy-and-fixup reduces overhead from 306 ms to 22.3 ms (13.7x) but requires rewriting two absolute-path pointers (.tickets-tracker/.git and .git/worktrees/gitdir), resetting the snapshot store key via REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR, re-randomizing .env-id and .signing-key, and clearing module-global caches.

Bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op when run inside a copy (validates against template's existing path, leaves copy pointing to template's object store) and must be rejected by a tier-wide autouse guard checking git worktree list --porcelain paths.

Template fixture must build in its own MonkeyPatch context pinning REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and clearing REBAR_TRACKER_DIR/BRANCH/CONFIG to prevent ambient test environment contamination baking into the shared template.
